rows.process: batch, cast, cure and demould beam/walkway concrete
cut/bend cage; position prestressing and verify cover
cut/machine reaction faces; retain, align and survey
investigate ground; construct foundation, pier and cap
fit fallback access attachments; removal requires evacuation approval
transport full span on surveyed access route
lift, locate, secure and inspect beam
temporary stability and ground bearing works
connect and align joints/reaction faces
possession/access planning and restricted-hour allowance
survey, material/connection records and independent checks

maintain road and pedestrian access during construction

base_cost_cases.limits: Quantity/process assumptions; site ground, force maps, manufacturing cycle times, prices and origins require qualification

excluded: complete evacuation devices and lifetime maintenance

qualify stock blocks; retain in replaceable cartridges
machine carriers/cores; wind, impregnate, assemble and calibrate

fabricate and verify capture, landing and emergency brake hardware
